objective:
A Node.js library that validates plain objects against a small schema.

It should provide: schema definitions for string, number, boolean, array and
object types; constraints for required fields, minimum and maximum, and regular
expression patterns; nested object and array-of-schema validation; error
reporting that names the failing path with a dotted key; and a coercion mode
that converts numeric strings to numbers before validating.

Pure Node standard library, tested with the built-in test runner. No
third-party dependencies.
